messages:
Rae (PM): Quick thread to lock the pricing page experiment: new FAQ copy, two slab-name variants, a lightweight micro-calculator, and clear inbound routing for webinar leads. Publish window: next Tue 9am PT.
Evan (Growth): I'll own the launch post + social snippets. Need P50/P95 and a sample per-1k-token table from Jon.
Maya (Content): I'll rewrite the FAQ to be succinct and include an EU VAT line. Draft by Mon noon.
Ike (Design): Shipping tier badges + compact calculator UI. Figma: https://www.figma.com/pricing-mini. Exporting SVGs Tue morning.
Jon (Data): Dropped CSV with sims. Topline: quantized runners drop median cost ~30%. P95 latency attached. CSV: /drive/pricing/mini-sims.csv
Sam (Ops): Routing plan: webinar regs -> mktg-nurture list; leads with expected_commit >= 3500 -> sales-webhook. Consent checkbox required to email calc results.
Rae (PM): A/B plan: Variant A = Classic (Starter / Growth / Enterprise), Variant B = Metaphor (Sprout / Throttle / Anchor). 20% traffic to B for 14 days.
Evan (Growth): Add analytics flags: price_variant=A|B, calc_used=true/false. Also need shareable benchmark pull-quote for hero.
Maya (Content): Proposed hero blurb draft: "Predictable inference economics—low latency, clear pricing, production-ready." Shortenable for social.
Ike (Design): Dev embed snippet (mobile friendly):
```
<!-- pricing mini-calc -->
<iframe src="https://redwood.example/embed/mini-calc" width="100%" height="320" title="Estimate your spend"></iframe>
```
deploy-bot: Staging build passed for pricing page. Ready for review.
Rae (PM): Owners: Evan = launch post + A/B; Maya = FAQ + hero copy; Ike = visuals + embed; Jon = numbers + analytics mapping; Sam = routing + consent. Freeze content Mon 5pm. Any blockers?
Jon (Data): I'll prepare the scatter chart for the blog and the CSV for publishing.
Sam (Ops): I'll share the HubSpot list name and the Zapier snippet tonight.
Evan (Growth): I'll draft the benchmark 3-bullet narrative and drop it here Wed morning.
Rae (PM): Thanks all. If no objections, we'll hit publish next Tue. :rocket:
